lines: Unhindered, in the self-made Lord, great Lord, wide powers abide;
that power-bearer I bow — god, churn-named, the world's one sap.
l4.sanskrit_cite: anargala svātmamaye maheśe tiṣṭhanti | taṃ śaktimantaṃ praṇamāmi devaṃ manthānasaṃjñaṃ jagadekasāram
